name: Sledge
summary: Shopify app for AI search, product filters, merchandising and offers such as bundles and upsells, with a free plan on development stores.
best_for: Shopify stores whose shoppers struggle to find products and that want search, filters and offers in one app
skip_if: your catalog is small and the built in Shopify search and filters already work for you, or you need proof that the paid plan helps on a live store
honest_knock: We tested only the free development store setup. On a live store the app says customers see none of the tools until you pick a paid plan, so the free plan is a trial bench, not a free tier. The Pro approval screen showed a real $29.99 charge with no test note, so the paid features, AI search, bundles and upsells, stayed untested. The listing shows three paid plans and the app shows a fourth at $399. The app asks for wide store access at install.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · Pro $29.99 a month on the Shopify App Store listing, read 26 November 2026
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-26 on apps.shopify.com/sledge, USD) Development store: free, 50 products indexed, no AI search. Pro: $29.99 a month, 10,000 products indexed, 14 day free trial. Scale: $89.99 a month, 200,000 products indexed, 14 day free trial. Accelerate: $199 a month, unlimited products indexed, 14 day free trial. The app also showed Ultimate at $399 a month. Charges are billed every 30 days.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed Sledge, turned on instant search and the product filter, and searched the theme preview. We did not approve the Pro plan and did not use a live store.
findings: Install: the permission screen lists customer data (sensitive data, device and activity data), staff and contributor data, and store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, store analytics, Online Store).
First result: about two minutes after install, instant search for snowboard returned three matching products in the theme preview, with 12 clicks and no configuration beyond the on buttons.
Filters: the collection page gained Availability and Price filters, a search box and sorting. They came from the product data without any setup.

Free plan: the app says you are on the free plan (up to 50 products), that on a development store everything works, and that on a live store customers see none of the tools until you pick a paid plan.

Pro: the Shopify approval screen showed $29.99 every 30 days with a 14 day trial ending on 5 December and no note that it was a test charge, so we did not approve it. Cancelling gave the message 'The shop cannot accept the provided charge.'
